steps.heading: Things you can see
steps.prompt: Look around you. Notice five things you can see, near or far.

steps.heading: Things you can hear or feel
steps.prompt: Listen, or notice your body. Find four things you can hear or feel.

steps.heading: Things you can touch
steps.prompt: Notice three things you can touch, like your sleeve or the seat beneath you.

steps.heading: Things you can smell
steps.prompt: Notice two things you can smell. If nothing comes, that is fine.

steps.heading: A taste or a kind thought
steps.prompt: Notice one thing you can taste, or think one kind thought about yourself.
